longTitle.officialTitle: To reauthorize the rural emergency medical service training and equipment assistance program, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Supporting and Improving Rural EMS Needs Reauthorization Act” or the “SIREN Reauthorization Act”.

section.heading: RURAL EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICE TRAINING AND EQUIPMENT ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
section.chapeau: Section 330J of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 254c-15) is amended—

paragraph.content: in subsection (a), by striking “the Administrator of the Health Resources and Services Administration (referred to in this section as the ‘Secretary’)” and inserting “the Assistant Secretary,”;

clause.content: in subparagraph (C), by striking “; and” and inserting a semicolon; and

by adding at the end the following:
“(E) ensure emergency medical services personnel are trained on mental health and substance use disorders and care for individuals with such disorders in emergency situations; and” ; and
in subparagraph (B), by striking “; or” and inserting a semicolon;
in subparagraph (C), by striking the period and inserting “; or”; and

paragraph.content: in subsection (f)(1), as so redesignated, by striking “2019 through 2023” and inserting “2024 through 2028”;
by redesignating such section 330J as section 553 of the Public Health Service Act; and
by transferring such section 553, as so redesignated, to appear at the end of part D of title V of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 290dd et seq.).
